title.zh: 电池为什么就是装不下更多电
title.en: Why Can't a Battery Just Hold More?

desc.zh: 从半反应、法拉第常数和能斯特方程一路算到电芯能量密度、快充、热失控、衰老和成本，再看 2026 年的前沿：十个用真实方程搭的可动手模型。
desc.en: From half-reactions, Faraday's constant and the Nernst equation to cell energy density, fast charging, thermal runaway, ageing and cost, then the 2026 frontier: models built on the equations the field actually uses.

desc.zh: 电池电压是两个电极电势之差，每摩尔电子做的最大功是 ΔG = −nFE；锂电池的电压高到水扛不住，只能用有机电解液。
desc.en: A cell's voltage is the difference of two electrode potentials and the maximum work per mole of electrons is ΔG = −nFE; lithium cells exceed water's window, so they need organic electrolytes.

en: why is a lithium battery 3.7 volts
where does battery voltage come from

title.zh: 比容量与电芯能量密度
title.en: Specific capacity and cell energy density

desc.zh: Q = nF/(3.6M) 决定材料每克存多少电；理论值到电芯要扣掉粘结剂、箔、隔膜、电解液和外壳，只剩一半左右。
desc.en: Q = nF/(3.6M) sets how much charge a gram of material stores; from theory to a real cell, binder, foils, separator, electrolyte and can remove about half.

zh: 电池能量密度为什么涨得慢

title.zh: 开路电压曲线：固溶体与两相
title.en: Open-circuit voltage: solid solution versus two phases

desc.zh: 格子气（正规溶液）模型给出能斯特方程的推广；相互作用够强时两相共存，电压成平台，磷酸铁锂因此难以靠电压估电量。
desc.en: The lattice-gas (regular solution) model generalises the Nernst equation; strong attraction splits the host into two phases with a flat plateau, which is why LFP state of charge is hard to read from voltage.

en: why does my battery percentage jump

title.en: Solid-state diffusion in an electrode particle

desc.zh: 锂在颗粒里按菲克定律扩散，填满的时间约为 R²/D；颗粒越小、电极越薄，充得越快。
desc.en: Lithium diffuses into a particle by Fick's law and filling takes about R²/D; smaller particles and thinner electrodes charge faster.

title.zh: 恒流-恒压充电与快充极限
title.en: CC-CV charging and the limits of fast charging

desc.zh: 过电位、内阻和扩散让端电压提前碰到上限，恒压阶段电流衰减，所以最后 20% 很慢；低温快充会析锂。
desc.en: Overpotential, resistance and diffusion push the terminal voltage to its limit early, so the constant-voltage tail is slow; fast charging in the cold risks lithium plating.

en: why does charging slow down after 80%

desc.zh: 放热随温度指数增长而散热近似线性，反应物耗尽前放热压过散热就停不下来；磷酸铁锂比三元更晚、更温和。
desc.en: Heat release grows exponentially with temperature while cooling grows roughly linearly; if release wins before reactants run out, temperature runs away. LFP starts later and peaks lower than NMC.

title.en: Battery ageing: SEI growth and cycling

desc.zh: 负极表面膜按 √t 增厚、慢慢吃掉锂；半经验模型把日历老化和循环老化分开，温度和平均电量是最大的旋钮。
desc.en: The anode surface film thickens roughly as √t and consumes lithium; semi-empirical models split calendar and cycle ageing, with temperature and mean charge the biggest levers.

zh: 为什么电池越用越不经用
en: why does my battery hold less charge over time

title.en: The learning curve of battery prices

desc.zh: 累计产量每翻一倍，锂电池电芯价格降约 20–30%（莱特定律），学习率取决于拟合区间；正极材料是最大的成本项。
desc.en: Each doubling of cumulative production has cut lithium-ion cell prices by about 20–30% (Wright's law), depending on the fitted period; the cathode is the largest cost item.

zh: 电池为什么越来越便宜

title.zh: 电池前沿（2026）：固态、硅负极、钠离子、快充
title.en: The battery frontier (2026): solid-state, silicon, sodium-ion, fast charging

desc.zh: 按已确立、已演示和厂商声称分开列出截至 2026 年 11 月的数据，并算出每千瓦时锂的下限。
desc.en: Facts as of November 2026 sorted into established, demonstrated and claimed, plus the minimum lithium per kWh.
